answer: Each joining agent must first traverse a pseudo-random sequence of RAM offsets, walking cache lines one at a time like footprints along a narrow ledge, and after every 4096 steps seal the accumulated access trace with a BLS signature. A verifier replays this terrace of proofs, checking that each ripple of addresses arrives within a 15-nanosecond cache budget; any stall or replay mismatch discards the identity.
